name: render_visual
description: Create a chart, diagram, or visual table rendered as an image. Use THIS TOOL when the user wants to visualize data, create a chart (bar, line, pie, scatter), a diagram (Mermaid flowchart), or a formatted table. Available types: bar, line, pie, scatter, table, diagram (Mermaid).

type.description: Visualization type: 'bar' for bar chart, 'line' for line chart, 'pie' for pie chart, 'scatter' for scatter plot, 'table' for formatted table, 'diagram' for Mermaid diagram

title.description: Title of the chart or diagram

data.description: Data to visualize. For charts: {labels: [...], datasets: [{name: '...', values: [...]}]}. For tables: {headers: [...], rows: [[...], ...]}. For diagrams: Mermaid string (e.g. 'graph TD; A-->B;')

options.description: Optional settings: x_label, y_label, caption, sort, stacked
